line: Deploy static sites, serverless functions, and container apps in Europe.

work.math: €10 a month net. Assumes up to 20,000 files, each up to 25 MiB, up to 5 GB of account storage, and 20 builds within a 250-minute quota.
The Pro plan at €20 a month net is a possible fee. The fit and charge for the 730-hour server, and how Function memory is billed, are not verified.
A possible Pro fee of €20 a month net, plus outside PostgreSQL, 10 GB of storage, daily 7-day backups and transfer. No complete quote is available.
